Rashi on Bava Kamma 12a:12:1.hebrew: חצר מהלכת היא - אינה קונה לבעליה כלום, דלאו חצר היא במהלכת:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 12a:12:1.english: It is a mobile courtyard - It does not acquire anything for its owner, since it is not [considered] a courtyard when mobile.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 12a:13:1.hebrew: והלכתא - הא דמתרצינן דקנה ליה עבד בעודן עליו, כגון שהעבד כפות שאינו ראוי לילך, דדמי לחצר:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 12a:13:1.english: And the halakha [is] - That which we resolved, that the slave acquires [them] while they are upon him, [is in a case] such as where the slave is bound so that he is not fit to walk, for [then] he is similar to a courtyard.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 12a:14:1.english: But isn't it taught [in a baraita]: If he took possession of land, he acquires slaves - And above it taught that he does not acquire [them].

Rashi on Bava Kamma 12a:15:1.english: Where they are standing within it - And that [case] above [is] where they are not standing within it.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 12a:17:1.hebrew: הניחא להך לישנא - דאוקי רב איקא לעיל לההיא מתני' דעבדי כמטלטלי דמי כו':
Rashi on Bava Kamma 12a:17:1.english: This works out well according to that formulation - Where Rav Ika earlier established that Mishnah [as meaning] that slaves are like movable property, etc.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 12a:1:2.english: Ulla said to them - to those sitting before him.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 12a:1:3.hebrew: הכי אמר ר' אלעזר אפילו מיתמי - דעבדא כמקרקעי דמי:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 12a:1:3.english: This is what Rabbi Elazar said: Even from orphans - For a slave is like real estate.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 12a:1:4.hebrew: אשתמטין עולא - נשמט ממני, וירא משום דס"ל עבדא כמטלטלי דמי, ומתיירא הוא שמא אקפחנו בהלכות ובקושיות:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 12a:1:4.english: Ulla evaded me - He slipped away from me and was afraid, because he holds [that] a slave is like movable property, and he fears lest I overwhelm him with legal rulings and objections.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 12a:2:1.hebrew: הוה עובדא ואגבו דייני דנהרדעא - אפי' מיתמי:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 12a:2:1.english: There was an incident, and the judges of Neharde'a collected - Even from orphans.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 12a:3:1.hebrew: הא עולא והא ר' אלעזר כו' - דכולהו סבירי להו כמקרקעי דמו:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 12a:3:1.english: There is Ulla, and there is Rabbi Elazar, etc. - For all of them hold [that slaves] are like land.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 12a:3:2.hebrew: מר - דאמר כמטלטלי, כמאן ס"ל:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 12a:3:2.english: The Master - who said [that slaves are] like movable property, in accordance with whom does he hold?

Rashi on Bava Kamma 12a:4:1.english: Prosbol - [It is] explained in Gittin (36a) that Hillel the Elder instituted a prosbol so that the Sabbatical year would not cancel the loan.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 12a:4:2.hebrew: חל על הקרקע - דכיון דלא מחוסרי גוביינא, וזה כתב לו עליהן שכל חוב שיש לו עליו שיגבנו כל זמן שירצה, קיימי ברשותיה דמלוה:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 12a:4:2.english: Takes effect upon the land - For since [the lands] are not lacking collection, and this one wrote to him upon them that any debt that he has against him he may collect whenever he wishes, they stand in the possession of the lender.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 12a:4:3.hebrew: נקנין עם הקרקע - אם מכר לו קרקע ומטלטלין והחזיק בקרקע, קנה מטלטלין, אע"פ שלא משך:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 12a:4:3.english: [Movable property] is acquired together with the land - If [one] sold him land and movable property and [the buyer] took possession of the land, he acquires the movable property, even though he did not pull [it].

Rashi on Bava Kamma 12a:4:4.hebrew: ואין נקנין עם העבדים - שאם החזיק בעבדים לא קנה מטלטלין, ויכול מוכר לחזור במטלטלין. אלמא עבדא כמטלטלי:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 12a:4:4.english: And they are not acquired together with the slaves - For if [the buyer] took possession of the slaves, he has not acquired the movable property, and the seller can retract regarding the movable property. Thus, a slave is [treated] like movable property.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 12a:6:1.hebrew: ה"ג בקרקע לא קנה עבדים - ואע"ג דס"ל להאי תנא עבדים כמטלטלין דמי, אפ"ה לא קנה אלא א"כ עומד העבד בתוכה בשעה שהחזיק בה, כדמתרץ לקמן: שאני מטלטלי דניידי ממטלטלי דלא ניידי:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 12a:6:1.english: This is the reading: [If he took possession] of the land, he does not acquire [the] slaves - Even though this Tanna holds [that] slaves are like movable property, nevertheless he does not acquire [them] unless the slave is standing within [the land] at the time he takes possession of it, as [the Gemara] answers below: "Movable property that moves is different from movable property that does not move."

Rashi on Bava Kamma 12a:9:1.hebrew: דומיא דערים מצורות - דמהאי קרא נפקא לן במס' קדושין דמטלטלין נקנין בחזקת קרקעות, דכתיב "ויתן להם אביהם מתנות עם ערי מצורות". הלכך, בעינן מקרקעי דלא ניידי כי התם:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 12a:9:1.english: Similar to “fortified cities” - For from this verse we derive in Tractate Kiddushin that movable property is acquired through taking possession of land, as it is written: “And their father gave them gifts ... with fortified cities.” Therefore, we require land that does not move around, like there.

Tosafot on Bava Kamma 12a:13:1.hebrew: והלכתא בכפות - וצ"ל נמי דמיירי בישן, דכפות מהני דלא הוי חצר מהלכת, וישן מהני דהוי משתמרת לדעתו, כדאמרינן בגיטין פרק הזורק (גיטין דף עח.) גבי "כתב גט לאשתו ונתנו ביד עבדו ישן ומשמרתו — ה"ז גט; ניעור — אין גט, משום דהוי חצר המשתמרת שלא מדעתה". ופריך: "ישן אמאי הוי גט? חצר מהלכת הוא! וכ"ת ישן שאני — והאמר רבא: כל שאילו מהלך לא קנה, עומד ויושב לא קנה; והלכתא בכפות!" אלמא אע"ג דמוקי לה בכפות, אפ"ה ניעור אינו גט. ואין לפרש "הלכתא בכפות" — כלומר לא חשיב מהלכת ולא דמי לעומד ויושב, וכיון דכפות מועיל ישן נמי מועיל — דא"כ, דבשאין כפות איירי רבא, אמאי קאמר רבא "ניעור אין גט משום דהוי חצר המשתמרת שלא לדעתה"? תיפוק ליה דהוי חצר מהלכת! וכן פ"ה פרק הזורק: "והלכתא בכפות", ובההוא קאמר רבא דניעור אין גט. וכן פסקו הלכות גדולות, דכפות וישן בעינן:
Tosafot on Bava Kamma 12a:13:1.english: And the halakha is when [he is] bound - And it must also be said that it is speaking of when [he is] asleep, for being bound is effective so that he is not [considered] a moving courtyard, and being asleep is effective so that it is [a courtyard] guarded with his [master's] knowledge, as we say in Gittin, chapter HaZorek (Gittin 78a), regarding [the Mishnah]: "If one wrote a bill of divorce for his wife and placed it in the hand of his slave while he is asleep and she is guarding him — behold, this is a [valid] bill of divorce; if he is awake — it is not a [valid] bill of divorce, because he is a courtyard guarded without her knowledge." And [the Gemara] challenges: "When he is asleep, why is it a [valid] bill of divorce? He is a moving courtyard! And if you should say that when he is asleep it is different — did not Rava say: Anything which, if it were walking, would not acquire, when standing or sitting it does not acquire; and the halakha is [that it acquires] when bound!" Thus we see that even though [the Gemara] establishes it as [speaking of] when he is bound, even so, when he is awake it is not a [valid] bill of divorce. And one should not explain "the halakha is when [he is] bound" [to mean] — that is to say, [when asleep] he is not considered a moving [courtyard] and is not comparable to one standing or sitting, and since being bound is effective, being asleep is also effective — for if so, that Rava is speaking of when he is not bound, why did Rava say, "When he is awake it is not a [valid] bill of divorce because he is a courtyard guarded without her knowledge"? Let it emerge [simply] because he is a moving courtyard! And so explained the Kuntres [Rashi] in chapter HaZorek: "And the halakha is when [he is] bound," and regarding that [case of a bound slave] Rava said that when he is awake it is not a [valid] bill of divorce. And so ruled the Halakhot Gedolot, that we require [him to be both] bound and asleep.

Tosafot on Bava Kamma 12a:15:1.hebrew: בעומדין לתוכה - והא דקאמר "לא קנה" — באין עומדין לתוכה, ואפ"ה במטלטלין קנה, דלא בעינן צבורין במטלטלין דלא ניידי. ולקמן דדייקינן "והא קי"ל דלא בעינן צבורין", מגופה הוה מצי למידק:
Tosafot on Bava Kamma 12a:15:1.english: Where they are standing within it - And that which [the baraita] says, "he has not acquired [the slaves]," [refers to a case] where they are not standing within it, and even so, regarding movable property he does acquire [it], because we do not require [them to be] piled [upon the land] in the case of movable property that does not move [on its own]. And later, when [the Gemara] infers, "But we hold that we do not require [them to be] piled [upon the land]," [the Gemara] could have inferred [this] from [the baraita] itself.

Tosafot on Bava Kamma 12a:18:1.hebrew: למה לי עומדין בתוכה - פי': על כרחך לא מטעם חצר קנה, דסתם עבדים אין משתמרין לדעתו ואפי' עומד בצד שדהו, דהוי עבד כצבי רץ כדרכו. ומטעם אגב נמי לא קנה, דקרקע אין נקנית אגב קרקע, ואפי' אמר: "קני קרקע הסמוכה לתחום ואגבה תקנה העליונה", דהשתא הוי זו על גב זו — לא קני באגב. אלא ע"כ, הא דקני — היינו מחמת דחשיב כמחובר; וא"כ, אפי' אין עומדין בתוכה נמי, דהוי כעשר שדות בעשר מדינות — כיון שהחזיק באחת מהן קנה כולן. והא דקאמר שמואל בפרק חזקת הבתים (ב"ב דף נד.): "לא קנה אלא מקום מכושו בלבד" — היינו בנכסי הגר דהפקר, אבל אם דעת אחרת מקנה אותו — קנה הכל. והא דקאמר התם דמצר מפסיק — היינו נמי בנכסי הגר, או במכר ולא נתן להם דמי כולם, דדמי כולם בעינן כדמוכח בפ"ק דקדושין (דף כז:):
Tosafot on Bava Kamma 12a:18:1.english: Why do I [need them to be] standing within it - Explanation: Perforce he does not acquire [them] by the principle of a courtyard [chatzer], for ordinary slaves are not guarded with his awareness even when he is standing beside his field, since a slave is like a deer running on its own way. And by the principle of agav [acquisition by way of land] he does not acquire [them] either, for land is not acquired agav land; even if he said, "Acquire the land adjacent to the boundary, and agav it you shall acquire the upper one," so that now it is one on top of the other — one does not acquire [land] through agav. Rather, perforce, that which he acquires [them] is because [the slave] is considered like something attached [to the land]; and if so, even if they are not standing within it as well [he should acquire them], for it is like ten fields in ten countries — once he takes possession of one of them, he has acquired all of them. And that which Shmuel says in the chapter Chezkat HaBatim (Bava Batra 54a), "He acquires only the place of his hoe alone" — that is regarding the property of a convert [who died without heirs], which is ownerless, but if another person's intent [i.e., a seller or giver] transfers it to him, he acquires everything. And that which he says there that a boundary marker interrupts — that is also regarding the property of a convert, or in a sale where he did not give them the money for all of them, for we require the money for all of them, as is proven in the first chapter of Kiddushin (27b).

Tosafot on Bava Kamma 12a:2:1.english: "Go and return" - [Rav Nachman] considers them like one who errs in a matter of Mishnah.

Tosafot on Bava Kamma 12a:4:1.hebrew: אנא מתניתא ידענא - אע"ג דבכמה דוכתין אשכחן דכמקרקעי דמי לענין אונאה ושבועה, אור"י דהכא לא איירי אלא במילי דרבנן, ולגבות מיתמי ומלקוחות — וסבר שעבודא לאו דאורייתא, ולא גבי אלא מדרבנן — ולענין פרוזבול וקנין אגב, דהוי נמי מדרבנן, וקרא דערים מצורות אסמכתא בעלמא היא. ולקמן דקאמר, להך לישנא דאמר עבדא כמקרקעי דמי, "למה לי עומדים בתוכה" — למ"ד נמי כמטלטלי דמי הוה מצי למיפרך, דהא לא חשיב כמטלטלי אלא לענין מילי דרבנן, אלא דבלאו הכי פריך שפיר. והא דבעי למידק בפ' המוכר את הבית (ב"ב סח.) אי עבדא כמטלטלי דמי או כמקרקעי דמי ממתני' דהיו בה עבדים ובהמה כולן מכורין, ומייתי לה נמי בפרק מי שמת (בבא בתרא קנ.) גבי מטלטלין של פלוני — לא שייכא הכא כלל, דהתם בלשון בני אדם תלינן:
Tosafot on Bava Kamma 12a:4:1.english: I know a baraita - Although in several places we find that [a slave] is considered like land with respect to price fraud (ona'ah) and oaths, Ri says that here [the Gemara] is speaking only of rabbinic matters: both regarding collecting from orphans and from purchasers — for he holds that a lien is not biblical, and one only collects rabbinically — and regarding prosbol and acquisition by dint of land (kinyan agav), which are also rabbinic, and the verse of "fortified cities" is merely a scriptural support (asmachta). And later, where [the Gemara] says, according to that version which says a slave is like land, "Why do I need [them] standing in it?" — even according to the one who says [a slave] is like movable property, it could have objected, since [a slave] is only considered like movable property with respect to rabbinic matters; however, even without that it objects well. And that which [the Gemara] seeks to infer in the chapter [entitled] HaMokher Et HaBayit (Bava Batra 68a) whether a slave is like movable property or like land from the Mishnah [stating that if] there were slaves and livestock in it, all of them are sold, and brings it also in the chapter [entitled] Mi SheMet (Bava Batra 150a) regarding "the movable property of so-and-so" — [this] does not belong here at all, for there we depend on people's [ordinary] usage of language.

Tosafot on Bava Kamma 12a:4:2.hebrew: פרוזבול חל על הקרקע - אין כותבין פרוזבול אלא על דבר שאי אפשר לכלותו, ואע"ג שכותבין על עציץ נקוב (גיטין לז.) — כיון דחשיב קרקע, לא פלוג רבנן:
Tosafot on Bava Kamma 12a:4:2.english: A prosbol takes effect upon land - A prosbol is only written on something that cannot be destroyed; and even though one writes [it] on a perforated flowerpot (Gittin 37a), since it is considered land, the Rabbis did not differentiate.

Tosafot on Bava Kamma 12a:6:1.hebrew: מכר לו עבדים וקרקעות - בקנין אגב איירי, דאי מטעם חצר, אמאי מפליג בהחזיק בקרקע בין עבדים למטלטלין? דאי משתמרת לדעתו — בתרוייהו קני, ואי באין משתמרת לדעתו — בתרוייהו לא קנה:
Tosafot on Bava Kamma 12a:6:1.english: "If one sold him slaves and land" - [The baraita] is speaking of acquisition by way of [land] (kinyan agav), for if [the acquisition were] by virtue of [the law of] a courtyard, why does it distinguish, when he takes possession of the land, between slaves and movable property? For if [the land] is guarded with his knowledge, he acquires [them] in both cases; and if [the case is] where it is not guarded with his knowledge, he does not acquire [them] in either case.

Tosafot on Bava Kamma 12a:9:1.hebrew: בעינן דומיא דערים מצורות - והחזיק בקרקע לא קנה עבדים, משום דאין קרקע נקני' באגב:
Tosafot on Bava Kamma 12a:9:1.english: "We require [land] similar to fortified cities" - And [as for the ruling that if] he took possession of land, he does not acquire slaves — [that is] because land is not acquired agav [together with other land].
